title: Relationship CRM Service envelope boundary
summary: The provider projects Odoo evidence to canonical CRM objects, then dev11 creates ordered idempotent service envelopes without taking over persistence, policy or Queue Fabric delivery.
invariants: OdooRelationshipCRMAdapter is a semantic projection boundary, not a shared mutable database.
Command identity is stable for command type, canonical object identity, actor and role; Relationship CRM Service owns semantic fingerprint conflict detection.
The same SIP Call-ID or Interaction Event reference is retained as correlation/causation evidence.
Relationship CRM Service remains authoritative for idempotency, durable state, policy projection, outbox and Queue Fabric worker behaviour.
procedure: Project a call context with OdooRelationshipCRMAdapter.
Submit those envelopes through the existing Relationship CRM Service boundary; do not bypass it with direct repository mutation.

provenance.claim: service envelope, idempotency and command handling contract
